questions.questionText: If a ⊗ b = a×b + a, find the positive value of x for which x ⊗ 7 = 96.

questions.questionText: For two positive integers, a ∆ b is defined as a − b if a is greater than b, otherwise b − a plus 1. Find the value of (6 ∆ 3) ∆ 2.
questions.explanation: 6 ∆ 3: apply the condition to (6, 3) to get 3. Then 3 ∆ 2: apply the condition to (3, 2) to get 1.
questions.shortcut: Check the condition separately at each of the two steps - it can switch branch.

questions.questionText: For two positive integers, a ★ b is defined as the sum of a and b if it is even, otherwise the product of a and b. Find the value of (12 ★ 9) ★ 7.
questions.explanation: 12 ★ 9: apply the condition to (12, 9) to get 108. Then 108 ★ 7: apply the condition to (108, 7) to get 756.
questions.shortcut: Check the condition separately at each of the two steps - it can switch branch.
